Find out where a refund is

phonetically_fragile_spans.why: alphanumeric ids mis-recognise in noisy audio
spoken dates collapse across similar-sounding numbers

observable_behaviors: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.
Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.
Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.
Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.
Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

rules.name: Scan truth
rules.rule: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.

rules.name: No delivery promises
rules.rule: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.

rules.name: Complaint window
rules.rule: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.

rules.name: COD handling
rules.rule: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.

forbidden_actions: Promising a delivery date no tool returned.
Raising a complaint before the promised window elapses.
Telling a COD customer money will be refunded before pickup.

rules.name: Eligibility first
rules.rule: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.

rules.name: Route truth
rules.rule: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.

rules.name: Replacement-only categories
rules.rule: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.

rules.name: Refund after pickup
rules.rule: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

forbidden_actions: Scheduling a pickup for an ineligible return.
Offering a refund where the policy allows only replacement.
Quoting a credit timeline the tool did not return.

check_return_eligibility.purpose: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

issue_refund.purpose: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

lookup_order.purpose: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

raise_delivery_complaint.purpose: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

schedule_pickup.purpose: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

track_shipment.purpose: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

order_tracking.purpose: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
order_tracking.business_context: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

terminal_success_conditions: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.
Customer told exactly where the shipment is and what happens next.
escalation_conditions: Customer states the courier marked it delivered and threatens legal action.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

returns_refunds.purpose: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.
returns_refunds.business_context: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

terminal_success_conditions: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.
Customer told why the item cannot be returned and what the alternative is.
escalation_conditions: Customer claims the item was defective outside every window.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
